notes.title: New Release Features & Fixes
notes.content:
Hi,

The new release will come in the next two weeks will  include following features:

- Video Recording 
- Sound Input Selection in App
- F11 key for full screen 

and a fix for:

- Slideshow problem

A preview of the Video Recording feature will be available in the next days as video on our community page. 

Stay tuned and share your thoughts.

Kind Regards
VJmachine Development
